intro.text: An Allomantic metal that hides its burner's future from enemies burning atium, whose view of the burner splits apart.
An alloy of gold and silver. Allomancers burn it to see their own possible futures, a cheap counter to atium, and Feruchemists store determination in it.

description.text: When an Allomancer burning atium faces someone burning electrum, the electrum burner's atium shadow splits, so their actions cannot be predicted.

An electrum Misting, or Oracle, sees shadows of their own possible futures a few seconds ahead, like atium shadows. Because gold and silver are far cheaper than atium, Elend called it the poor man's atium.
A Feruchemist storing determination in electrum becomes depressed while filling it, and can tap it afterward to enter a manic state.

items.text: The Lord Ruler kept electrum from public knowledge, since it would have destroyed the value of atium and the economy built on it.
Sazed sought out the metal plate left with the Urteau storage cache, which held information on electrum.
When Yomen, burning atium, seemed unnaturally fast in a fight, Elend burned electrum and left him confused.
